tagline: New customer accounts wait for your approval before they can sign in, with rules per website, an approval queue and emails to your team and your customers.
key_features: Approval for all new accounts or selected customer groups
Auto-approve customer groups and email domains
Sign-in blocked until approved, on every sign-in path
Approval Queue with search, filters and status badges
Approve and Reject on the customer page, with a reason
Emails to the shop team and to the customer
REST API, CLI and an event for integrations
Hyvä and Luma registration notice included

benefits.title: Trade and B2B shops
benefits.text: Only the customers you approve can sign in, see their account and order. Everyone else gets a clear message.

benefits.title: No back doors
benefits.text: Pending and rejected customers are refused on the sign-in page, at checkout, through REST and GraphQL tokens and through password-less sign-ins.

benefits.title: Less manual work
benefits.text: Auto-approve your own groups and trusted email domains, and approve the rest from one queue or in bulk.

showcase.label: Registration
showcase.title: Tell shoppers before they register
showcase.text: An optional notice above the registration form explains that accounts are reviewed. After registering, the customer is not signed in and sees your approval message.

showcase.label: Sign-in
showcase.title: A clear message instead of an account
showcase.text: A pending or rejected customer who tries to sign in sees your message for that status. The texts can be changed per store view.

showcase.label: Hyvä
showcase.title: Native Hyvä template
showcase.text: The registration notice has its own Hyvä template, picked automatically. Sign-in messages appear in Hyvä's own message area.

showcase.label: Approval Queue
showcase.title: Every waiting account in one grid
showcase.text: Pending and rejected accounts with keyword search, filters and status badges. Approve or reject in bulk; the menu shows how many are waiting.

showcase.label: Customer page
showcase.title: Approve or Reject on the customer page
showcase.text: A notice shows the status, and the Reject button asks for an optional reason that can be included in the email to the customer.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Rules per website
showcase.text: Choose who needs approval, which groups and email domains are approved straight away, the storefront messages and the emails.
